prompt: Write $100{,}000$ using exponent notation with a base of $10$.

hints.text: The number of zeros becomes the exponent on the $10$.

explanation: Each zero comes from one factor of $10$: $10 \times 10 \times 10 \times 10 \times 10$.
Five factors of $10$ is written $10^5$, so $100{,}000 = 10^5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Say it out loud
steps: Hundred is $10^2$ and thousand is $10^3$, and $2 + 3 = 5$ factors of ten in all ✓
